read.thesis: Colgate's Q1 volume and pricing were broad-based, but a ~$300M raw-material and logistics hit cut gross margin guidance to down year-on-year, with oil assumed at about $110 per barrel.

triggers.label: Gross margin guide cut; $300M cost hit
triggers.quote: Since the fourth quarter call, we've seen an additional raw materials and logistics impact for the year of roughly $300 million.

triggers.label: Oil byproduct spend up >20% YoY
triggers.quote: we now expect that spending in those areas to be up more than 20% year-on-year for the full year.

triggers.label: Organic growth accelerated; Hill's up 4.8%
triggers.quote: Organic sales growth accelerated from the fourth quarter, driven by improved volume performance, particularly in Asia Pacific.

triggers.label: SGPP savings $200–300M, ends 2028
triggers.quote: we now expect that we'll be able to generate $200 million to $300 million of savings over the term of the program.

guidance.quote: we've maintained our organic sales growth guidance in the 1% to 4%
